newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: TENNIS-SCHETT, NAGYOVA IN STYRIAN OPEN FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SCHETT, NAGYOVA IN STYRIAN OPEN FINAL.

text.p: Fifth-seeded Austrian Barbara Schett breezed into the final of the Styrian Open with a 6-4 6-1 victory over Spain's Maria Sanchez-Lorenzo on Saturday.
Schett, 21, who recorded her only WTA tournament victory in Palermo last year, will meet sixth-seeded Slovak Henrieta Nagyova in Sunday's final of the clay court event.
Nagyova, who won their only previous meeting in straight sets, had little trouble getting past unseeded German Meike Babel 6-1 7-6 (7-5), to reach her second final in a fortnight.
"She (Nagyova) will be difficult to beat, but I will try my best," said Schett, 39th in the WTA rankings.
"I am very pleased with my performance," she added. "I haven't played this well in a long time."
Nagyova complained of fatigue after beating Babel. "I am already really tired, but I hope I can win," the world number 35 said.
